files.app/hooks.py:
from fastapi import FastAPI, Request
from app.git_ops import checkout

api = FastAPI()


@api.post("/hook")
async def hook(req: Request):
    payload = await req.json()
    checkout(payload["ref"].split("/")[-1])
    return {"ok": True}
